verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Fathom itself surfacing past meetings with the same attendees, or generating a brief of open threads, ahead of an upcoming call. The closest items are an API filter for meetings by company domain, which is a developer building block, and post-call features such as summaries, action items, cross-call search and Deal View. These are adjacent capabilities and earn no credit toward pre-meeting prep.

support.subject: As a founder, I walk into each meeting prepped — the tool surfaces past meetings with the same people and a brief of open threads before the call
